name: Agent Hub
description: Cross-agent local Skills and MCP manager: scan Claude Code, Codex, Qoder, Trae, WorkBuddy and Pi; install skills from GitHub or archives; manage MCP server configs.
releaseNotes: 0.1.1: declares the read-only skills_list/skills_search/skills_get MCP tools so external clients can discover them; ships LICENSE and third-party OFL notice. 0.1.0 introduced local skill inventory, GitHub/ZIP/local import, center library, multi-client sync, drift detection, update checks, and MCP server config management.
